verdict.rationale: The docs give documented in-agent install commands for several harnesses. Claude Code uses `/plugin marketplace add` plus `/plugin install`, Devin CLI uses a one-liner (`devin plugins install obra/superpowers`), and Antigravity has a reinstallable command. Each states skills auto-trigger at session start via a SessionStart hook or context injection. A hands-on probe confirmed `npx skills add obra/superpowers` installs skills into `.claude/skills/`. Missing for 10: hands-on verification that skills are active in the next session (the probe only checked file installation); Claude Code needs two commands rather than one; some harnesses (Hermes, Codex/OpenCode) rely on a git clone or an agent-fetched INSTALL.md rather than a true one-liner.
